hero.subtitle: A free live webinar for parents and professionals who want to understand what is really driving a teen's risky behavior, and how connection can help them heal.
hero.description:
This webinar examines the relationship between trauma, stress, and substance use in adolescents.

Participants will learn how trauma affects the developing teen brain, why dopamine and emotional pain can increase vulnerability to risky behaviors, and how connection-based support can create safety, regulation, and healthier coping strategies for teens.

forYou.heading: This is for you if...
items: Your teen is pulling toward risky choices and you're scared of where it leads.
You've tried rules and consequences, but the behavior keeps escalating.
You sense there is pain underneath the behavior, not just rebellion.
You want to understand your teen's brain instead of fighting it.

learn.heading: What you'll walk away with
items: How trauma and chronic stress reshape the developing teen brain.
Why dopamine and emotional pain can pull teens toward risky, numbing behaviors.
How connection-based support creates safety and real regulation.
Healthier coping strategies you can foster at home, without fear or shame.

guide.name: Bryan Post
guide.bio: Bryan Post is an internationally recognized expert in adoption, attachment, and trauma, and the founder of the love-based, family-centered approach behind our program. For decades he has helped families move from fear and conflict toward connection, calm, and lasting healing.

trust.heading: Why families trust this webinar
trust.audience: Join adoptive and foster families from across California, supported by the Fear to Love methodology and the Love Pathways Wraparound team.
